name: PREVENCY Crisis Simulation
description: Commercial immersive digital crisis simulation platform for corporate and organizational crisis management training. Simulates realistic crisis scenarios with time pressure, information overload, and multi-stakeholder dynamics. Designed to train crisis management teams in rapid decision-making under extreme uncertainty.
reputation: established commercial platform used by European corporations and public sector organizations
notes: Commercial platform. Focus on corporate crisis scenarios including industrial accidents, cyberattacks, reputational crises, and natural disasters. Emphasizes information overload conditions.
